title: Dan's Silverleaf
venue_description:
Dan's Silverleaf - Your Favorite Musician's Favorite Venue

Dan's Silverleaf has operated as a locally-owned music venue and bar in downtown Denton Texas since 2002. The venue has built an extraordinary reputation among musicians and music lovers as one of the finest small music venues in Texas. Dan's earns its tagline your favorite musician's favorite venue through consistent commitment to quality music artist-friendly policies and genuine community focus. The intimate space creates an environment where audiences and performers connect authentically.

Essential Denton Music Venue

If you only have one night in Denton Dan's Silverleaf is the essential stop according to local music guides. The venue represents everything special about Denton's music scene - unpretentious authentic committed to original music and built by people who genuinely love music. The downtown location just off the Square positions Dan's at the heart of Denton's cultural district surrounded by other music venues restaurants and the vibrant street life that defines the city.

Weekly Open Mic and Song Swaps

Every Monday night at 8pm Dan's hosts Songwriter's Open Mic with Justin Collins. This weekly session welcomes original songs only - no covers - creating space for songwriters to share new material and works-in-progress. Doors open at 7:30pm and there is no cover charge. Beyond Mondays Dan's regularly hosts song swaps and songwriter circles where multiple artists share songs in rotation. These events create community among songwriters and provide audiences with intimate access to the creative process.

Diverse Booking and Programming

Dan's books an eclectic lineup spanning country folk Americana indie jazz and experimental music. The venue hosts local acts from Denton and the broader Dallas-Fort Worth area Texas artists on regional tours and national touring acts seeking intimate venues. Rock tribute bands provide crowd-pleasing variety while maintaining musical quality standards. The diverse programming ensures something for every musical taste while maintaining focus on original artistry and quality performance.

Artist-Friendly Policies and Quality Sound

Musicians consistently cite Dan's as a favorite venue because of fair treatment professional sound quality and respectful audiences. The venue provides quality sound equipment and experienced sound engineers ensuring performers sound their best. Artist payment and treatment meet professional standards. The intimate capacity creates an environment where artists can take risks and try new material knowing the audience came specifically to hear live music. These factors make Dan's a desired booking for touring artists.

Venue Layout and Amenities

The venue offers general admission standing room and limited seating. Tables for four can be reserved in advance for most shows providing comfortable viewing for those who prefer seated experiences. The bar serves cocktails beer wine and nonalcoholic options. While there is no kitchen on site patrons are welcome to bring food from nearby downtown restaurants. This policy supports both Dan's and surrounding food establishments.

Age Policy and Accessibility

All shows at Dan's are 21 and up with the exception that underage music fans can attend when accompanied by a parent or guardian. This policy balances maintaining a bar atmosphere with allowing families to share live music experiences. The venue is located right off the Denton Square with parking available in lots and along Industrial Hickory Mulberry and Sycamore streets. Walking from the Square takes just minutes.

Awards and Recognition

Dan's has earned numerous accolades including Best Bar in Denton and venue awards from the Dallas Entertainment Awards. In 2025 Rubber Gloves received recognition for best venue in the 301-1000 capacity category while Dan's continues earning praise in smaller venue categories. The sustained recognition across two decades demonstrates consistent quality and community value.

Part of Denton's Music DNA

Denton's identity as a music city is grounded in the University of North Texas College of Music one of the top music programs in America. This institutional foundation creates a city full of talented musicians music students and people who deeply value live music. Dan's Silverleaf serves as a key venue in this ecosystem - providing professional opportunities for emerging artists touring stops for established acts and consistent quality entertainment for the community. The venue represents the best of what makes Denton special.

Hours and Contact

Dan's Silverleaf is open Sunday through Thursday 3pm to midnight and Friday and Saturday 3pm to 2am. The venue is located at 103 Industrial Street in downtown Denton Texas. Tickets for most shows are available online through the venue website or at the door. The intimate capacity means popular shows can sell out so advance purchase is recommended for highly anticipated performances.
